snapshots.above_fold_structure: Full-bleed gradient background with large illustrated characters on right, bold headline 'REVENUE INTELLIGENCE' on left, small tagline and CTA button below.
Split layout with headline and CTA on left, interactive chat widget mockup on right, soft gradient background, navigation bar with logo and sign-in.

visual_shift_summary: The design evolved from a full-bleed cinematic hero with illustrated characters and bold messaging to a cleaner, more professional multi-column layout emphasizing product interface mockups and social proof through client logos. The visual language shifted from lifestyle imagery to product-centric UI demonstration.
